name: Bulbasaur
description_en: A small seed Pokemon that stores energy in the bulb on its back. Its body combines natural endurance with grass attacks.
description_pt: Um pequeno Pokemon de semente que guarda energia no bulbo em suas costas. Seu corpo mistura resistencia natural e ataques de planta.

name: Ivysaur
description_en: The bulb on its back grows heavier as it gathers energy for its final bloom.
description_pt: O bulbo em suas costas fica mais pesado enquanto reúne energia para sua flor final.

name: Venusaur
description_en: A fully grown flower releases a soothing scent and concentrates solar energy.
description_pt: Uma flor totalmente crescida libera um aroma suave e concentra energia solar.

name: Charmander
description_en: A fire lizard Pokemon with a burning tail. Its flame represents its vitality and battle spirit.
description_pt: Um Pokemon lagarto de fogo com uma chama na cauda. Sua chama representa sua vitalidade e seu espirito de batalha.

name: Charmeleon
description_en: Its fiery temperament burns brighter as its claws and flame grow stronger.
description_pt: Seu temperamento ardente fica mais intenso conforme suas garras e chama crescem.

name: Charizard
description_en: It flies through the sky while breathing flames hot enough to melt stone.
description_pt: Voa pelos céus enquanto solta chamas quentes o bastante para derreter pedra.

name: Squirtle
description_en: A tiny turtle Pokemon protected by a sturdy shell. It uses water attacks and solid defense to win battles.
description_pt: Um pequeno Pokemon tartaruga protegido por um casco resistente. Usa ataques de agua e defesa firme para vencer combates.

name: Wartortle
description_en: Its larger tail and tougher shell help it balance speed with defense.
description_pt: Sua cauda maior e casco mais resistente equilibram velocidade e defesa.

name: Blastoise
description_en: Powerful water cannons on its shell fire blasts with tremendous force.
description_pt: Canhoes de agua poderosos em seu casco disparam jatos com força enorme.

name: Caterpie
description_en: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
description_pt: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
description_en: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.
description_pt: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

name: Butterfree
description_en: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
description_pt: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Weedle
description_en: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.
description_pt: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.

name: Kakuna
description_en: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.
description_pt: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

name: Beedrill
description_en: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
description_pt: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

name: Pidgey
description_en: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
description_pt: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
description_en: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.
description_pt: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Pidgeot
description_en: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.
description_pt: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

name: Rattata
description_en: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.
description_pt: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

name: Raticate
description_en: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.
description_pt: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

name: Spearow
description_en: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.
description_pt: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

name: Fearow
description_en: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
description_pt: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

name: Ekans
description_en: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
description_pt: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

name: Arbok
description_en: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
description_pt: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

name: Pikachu
description_en: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
description_pt: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu
description_en: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
description_pt: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.

name: Sandshrew

description_pt: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

name: Sandslash

description_pt: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

name: Nidoran♀
description_en: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
description_pt: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidorina
description_en: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
description_pt: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

name: Nidoqueen
description_en: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
description_pt: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

name: Nidoran♂

description_pt: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

name: Nidorino
description_en: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
description_pt: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

name: Nidoking
description_en: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
description_pt: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.

name: Clefairy
description_en: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
description_pt: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

name: Clefable
description_en: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
description_pt: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Vulpix
description_en: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
description_pt: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

name: Ninetales
description_en: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
description_pt: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

name: Jigglypuff
description_en: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
description_pt: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
description_en: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
description_pt: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

name: Zubat
description_en: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
description_pt: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

name: Golbat

description_pt: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

name: Oddish
description_en: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
description_pt: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

name: Gloom
description_en: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
description_pt: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Vileplume
description_en: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
description_pt: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Paras
description_en: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.
description_pt: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.

name: Parasect
description_en: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.
description_pt: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

name: Venonat
description_en: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.
description_pt: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Venomoth
description_en: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
description_pt: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

name: Diglett
description_en: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
description_pt: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

name: Dugtrio
description_en: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
description_pt: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: Meowth
description_en: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
description_pt: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Persian
description_en: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
description_pt: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Psyduck
description_en: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
description_pt: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.

name: Golduck
description_en: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
description_pt: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

name: Mankey
description_en: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
description_pt: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.

name: Primeape
description_en: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
description_pt: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.

name: Growlithe
description_en: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
description_pt: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

name: Arcanine
description_en: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
description_pt: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

name: Poliwag
description_en: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
description_pt: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.

name: Poliwhirl
description_en: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
description_pt: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

name: Poliwrath
description_en: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
description_pt: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

name: Abra
description_en: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
description_pt: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

name: Kadabra
description_en: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
description_pt: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.

name: Alakazam
description_en: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
description_pt: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.

name: Machop
description_en: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
description_pt: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

name: Machoke
description_en: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
description_pt: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
description_en: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
description_pt: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

name: Bellsprout
description_en: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
description_pt: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

name: Weepinbell
description_en: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
description_pt: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

name: Victreebel
description_en: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
description_pt: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Tentacool
description_en: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
description_pt: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

name: Tentacruel
description_en: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
description_pt: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

name: Geodude
description_en: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
description_pt: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: Graveler
description_en: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
description_pt: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

name: Golem
description_en: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
description_pt: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

name: Ponyta
description_en: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
description_pt: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

name: Rapidash
description_en: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
description_pt: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Slowpoke
description_en: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
description_pt: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowbro
description_en: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
description_pt: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.

name: Magnemite
description_en: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
description_pt: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

name: Magneton
description_en: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
description_pt: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

name: Farfetch’d
description_en: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
description_pt: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

name: Doduo
description_en: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
description_pt: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

name: Dodrio
description_en: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
description_pt: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

name: Seel
description_en: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
description_pt: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Dewgong
description_en: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
description_pt: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

name: Grimer
description_en: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
description_pt: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

name: Muk
description_en: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
description_pt: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Shellder
description_en: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
description_pt: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Cloyster

description_pt: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

name: Gastly
description_en: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
description_pt: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

name: Haunter
description_en: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.
description_pt: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.

name: Gengar
description_en: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
description_pt: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

name: Onix
description_en: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
description_pt: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.

name: Drowzee
description_en: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
description_pt: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

name: Hypno
description_en: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
description_pt: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

name: Krabby
description_en: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
description_pt: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

name: Kingler
description_en: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
description_pt: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

name: Voltorb
description_en: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
description_pt: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.

name: Electrode
description_en: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
description_pt: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

name: Exeggcute

description_pt: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

name: Exeggutor

description_pt: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.

name: Cubone
description_en: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.
description_pt: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.

name: Marowak
description_en: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
description_pt: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

name: Hitmonlee
description_en: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
description_pt: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

name: Hitmonchan

description_pt: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.

name: Lickitung

description_pt: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

name: Koffing

description_pt: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

name: Weezing

description_pt: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.

name: Rhyhorn
description_en: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
description_pt: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

name: Rhydon

description_pt: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.

name: Chansey

description_pt: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.

name: Tangela

description_pt: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.

name: Kangaskhan

description_pt: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.

name: Horsea

description_pt: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

name: Seadra

description_pt: Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

name: Goldeen

description_pt: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.

name: Seaking

description_pt: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power­ fully up rivers and creeks.

description_pt: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

description_pt: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

description_pt: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

description_pt: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

name: Jynx

description_pt: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

description_pt: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

description_pt: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

description_pt: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

description_pt: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

description_pt: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Lapras
description_en: A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.
description_pt: A POKéMON that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.

name: Ditto
description_en: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.
description_pt: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

name: Eevee
description_en: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
description_pt: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.

name: Vaporeon
description_en: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
description_pt: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

name: Jolteon
description_en: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.
description_pt: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.

name: Flareon
description_en: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.
description_pt: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

name: Porygon
description_en: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.
description_pt: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

name: Omanyte
description_en: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.
description_pt: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

name: Omastar
description_en: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.
description_pt: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.

name: Kabuto
description_en: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
description_pt: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

name: Kabutops
description_en: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.
description_pt: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim­ ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

name: Aerodactyl
description_en: A ferocious, pre­ historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
description_pt: A ferocious, pre­ historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.

name: Snorlax
description_en: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.
description_pt: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

name: Articuno
description_en: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
description_pt: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: Zapdos
description_en: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
description_pt: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

name: Moltres
description_en: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
description_pt: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

name: Dratini
description_en: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.
description_pt: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.

name: Dragonair
description_en: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.
description_pt: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

name: Dragonite
description_en: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
description_pt: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

name: Mewtwo
description_en: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.
description_pt: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Mew
description_en: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
description_pt: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
